answers.core:
Because if this is on core, this can be easier to manipulate the collision without changing a lot of parameters and can be really useful to game developers create a game where can have a infinite sized world with proper collision, without worring with resolution, size, etc.

Obs: When I say infinite sized world, this is pratically not possible, as in very high positions, the collision and rendering behaves strangely.
answers.workaround: I don't think so, because this would need to rewrite the entire collision detection to be able to handle this kind of collision, as there isn't any way to manually write a custom collision solver with the current given Godot tools.
